post.description: You need licensed contractors of a given classification (B, C-10, C-53 ...) near a California ZIP code or in a city.

city.description: California city name (at least 4 characters, as the form requires). Exactly one of zip_code or city.

classification.description: Classification option value of the form: A, B, B-2, C-10, C-53, C-61/D-35, ASB, HAZ ... (C53 and c-53 are normalised to C-53; a limited specialty given by its D number alone, D-21 or D21 as get_license prints it, resolves to C-61/D-21).

zip_code.description: Five-digit ZIP code. Exactly one of zip_code or city. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

200.description:
The board's Find a Licensed Contractor search (ZipCodeSearch.aspx): currently licensed contractors holding one classification whose address of record is in a ZIP code or city. Two upstream requests (form GET for the WebForms state, then the search postback). Returns the board's count sentence value and every row of the result grid (license number, business name, address, city, ZIP, phone) in the board's randomly generated order; a search with no contractors is a successful empty result (count 0).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `classification` | object |  |
| `contractors` | object[] |  |
| `count` | number | The board's 'Your search returned a list of N licensed contractors' value. |
| `data_current_as_of` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `query` | object |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
The CSLB license detail page (LicenseDetail.aspx?LicNum=) for one contractor license number: business name and DBA, address lines, phone, entity type, issue/reissue/expire dates, the status sentence and whether the license is current and active, additional status lines and the complaint-disclosure link when the board shows one, classifications (code and name), every bond block (Contractor's Bond, Disciplinary Bond, Bond of Qualifying Individual: surety, bond number, amount, effective and cancellation dates, history link), the workers' compensation block (carrier, policy, dates, classification codes) and the Miscellaneous Information action lines. Dates are converted to YYYY-MM-DD; the board's 'Data current as of' stamp is kept verbatim. Fails with not_found when the board answers 'License Number does not exist.'

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action_items` | object[] | Miscellaneous Information lines ('MM/DD/YYYY - TEXT'); empty when the block is absent. |
| `additional_status` | string[] | Lines of the 'Additional Status' block (suspensions, disciplinary notes); empty when the block is absent. |
| `address_lines` | string[] | Address of record lines as printed (street or PO box, then 'CITY, ST ZIP'). |
| `bonds` | object[] |  |
| `business_name` | string |  |
| `classifications` | object[] |  |
| `complaint_disclosure_url` | string | ComplaintDisclosure.aspx link when the board flags complaint disclosure information for this license; null otherwise (B&P 7124.6). |
| `data_current_as_of` | string | The board's stamp verbatim, Pacific time (e.g. 'Data current as of 10/4/2026 1:55:16 PM'). |
| `dba` | string | The 'DBA ...' line of the business information block, without the DBA prefix; null when the license has no DBA line. |
| `entity_type` | string |  |
| `expire_date` | string |  |
| `issue_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD, or the board's text verbatim when it is not a date. |
| `license_number` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `personnel_url` | string |  |
| `phone` | string |  |
| `reissue_date` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status_is_active` | boolean | True when the status sentence says the license is current and active. |
| `status_text` | string | The board's status sentence, e.g. 'This license is current and active.' |
| `workers_comp` | object |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Business-name search of the CSLB license database (NameSearch.aspx): one page of up to 49 name rows whose business name starts with the given text, in the board's order, each with name type (Print = the name as printed on the license, Name = the business name of record, DBA, Previous), license number, city and status word. The board's result list is an alphabetical cursor over all names; rows outside the prefix are filtered out and an empty page is a successful empty result. A continuation is returned while every row on the page still matched the prefix.

The response contains the tool result directly.
